scope: Vocal cord dysfunction / inducible laryngeal obstruction.

keyRecommendations.text: Definitive diagnosis conventionally uses laryngoscopy showing inspiratory vocal-fold narrowing greater than 50%.
Laryngeal CT is described as a new technology that still requires validation in clinical pathways.
The roundtable emphasised case history before testing.

clinicalBottomLine: VCD/ILO is confirmed, in this report, by laryngoscopy demonstrating inspiratory vocal-fold narrowing of more than 50%, with history remaining central.
notableCaveats: CT of the larynx is mentioned as promising but not yet validated for routine pathways.
